title: MacroPulse Alert
message:
Trump rejects Iran 7-day Hormuz proposal; no-deal odds 96% by 23 Oct (Hormuz Day 232).
Oil (Brent) ~$108, -1.7% overnight; Russian supply return prospects dent 5-month rally.
December FOMC hike odds firming; October hike ~20% and easing. Gold rangebound on split signal.
BTC $82,769 weekend range (+1.6% from Friday); no threshold breach.
